seed_scope: No occurrence in local experiment/config JSON rosters; measurement-only new seeds, not confirmation.
eligibility: First native 10s epoch with eight feasible focal phases in [600,660]. First PP is one of eight branches; no outcome filter or replacement.
input: Direct t0 focal incoming/outgoing lane measurements; t0 positions; static lane/conflict graph; full joint focal nominal phases. Future signal states/response labels remain audit/label outputs.
safety: Require zero raw collision events and no teleports in both prefix and full 450s branch.
execution: Any focal nominal/actual ten-step mismatch holds the pilot for explanation. Actual signals never replace nominal inputs.
stopping: Stop the entire pilot on its first invalid/ineligible branch; keep partial measurements, never pad missing values with zero.
after_pass: Freeze one new model protocol and separate whole-seed source/target development budget. Do not fit on measurement pilot.
existing_gate: HOLD_RESPONSE remains closed; this is no fit, no cost readout, no closed loop.
